description: This Java source file defines the class 'ApplySavingsCommandStrategy' which implements a command strategy to apply savings to an existing client by utilizing the 'SavingsAccountsApiResource'. It handles execution of batch requests to apply savings, manages responses, and error handling within the context of the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ApplySavingsCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements {@link CommandStrategy} to process batch requests for applying savings to an existing client. It delegates the operation to 'SavingsAccountsApiResource' and constructs a batch response based on the result.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command strategy by invoking 'submitApplication' on the savingsAccountsApiResource, then constructs and returns a BatchResponse with the outcome.
